comment: Composite indexes required by the referral system. Firestore creates
single-field indexes automatically, so only queries that combine an
equality filter with an ordering or range on a different field appear
here. Deploy with: firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes
TTL policies cannot be expressed in this file. Create them in the
Firebase console (Firestore > TTL) on the `deleteAfter` field of both
`referralClicks` and `referralRateLimits`. Click rows are what make the
system forget visitors who never created an account.
This file is additive: it does not describe indexes that other parts of
Africin may already rely on. Merge rather than replace if the project
later adopts a single checked-in index manifest.
